body.name: supplied-design-tagged measurable decision families
body.construction:
Let \(D=(\mathcal X,\mathcal A,b,e)\) range over all supplied designs with nonempty finite \(\mathcal X\) and \(\mathcal A\) and with \(e(a\mid x)\le Lb(a\mid x)\).  Define \(\mathfrak E_T(t_0,\zeta,C;M_1,M_2)\) to be the set of families \((\widehat\theta_D)_D\) such that each
\[
 \widehat\theta_D:(\mathcal X\times\mathcal A\times\mathbb R)^T\longrightarrow\mathbb R
\]
is measurable.  The structural constants are fixed at the outer minimax problem, so the family may depend on \((t_0,\zeta,C,M_1,M_2)\); its component indexed by \(D\) may use the revealed alphabets and policies in \(D\), but not \(\mathcal H\), \(K\), \(d_b\), or \(d_e\).
